## Reviews

### code-reviewer: 1 must fix (fixed in S4-F5)

Boundaries clean: cross-module imports go through `index.ts`, repos touch their own schema, outbox events share the transaction, storage calls stay outside transactions, every route declares request and response schemas, every acceptance check has a named test.

- **Must fix — fixed:** `withDbErrors` named the access FK `…_agencies_id_fk`, but migration 0059 creates `…_agencies_agency_id_fk`. An unknown allowed agency answered **500** instead of `VALIDATION_FAILED`. Renamed; test `[S4-02]` now sends an unknown agency.
- Should fix → S5-F2: the orphan sweep never saves its cursor (objects past the first 100k keys are never swept); soft-deleted developments are never purged (their PDFs stay forever); overrides of purged listings and deleted units stay behind.
- Should fix → S5-F3: `listOwnDevelopments` / `listUnits` select every column; CSV price and unit-type parsing lives in the web app (business rule; S4-04 and S6 need it); a hard-coded `'EUR'` default.

### security-auditor: no must fix

All 12 new tenant tables are registered with RLS; `withSystem` only in workers and tests; every write goes through `assertCan` / `ownForChange`; Client Mode strips commission and the owner agency server-side; uploads check magic bytes, size and slots; signed URLs last 300 s.

Should fix → S5-F1 (Medium): PARTNER members of the owner agency can open its private development documents (listing documents already block them); access changes, commission changes and price-list approval write no audit entry; no test shows child rows (units, phases, documents) disappearing for an unverified reader, a suspended owner or a soft-deleted development. (Low): re-uploading the same file with `shared=true` silently returns the unshared row; `uploaded_by` / `legacy_id` sit in NETWORK_READ tables; unknown `allowedAgencyIds` let an admin probe agency ids; the browser reads CSVs of any size; override text must be escaped when the website renders it (S7-02, S12-04).

### perf-auditor: FAIL → fixed in S4-F5

- **Must fix — fixed:** the price-list list returned every version's full diff (up to 4,000 lines each; ~1 MB gzip for a page of 20). It now returns **counts only** (`PriceListSummaryDto`, computed in SQL — `jsonb_array_length`, no diff leaves the database); the full diff comes from `GET …/price-lists/:version`, which the panel loads when a version is opened. Test `[S4-F5]`.
- **Must fix — fixed:** `developments/csv.ts` imported the unit caps from `@inmolink/contracts`, bundling zod into the development page (229.4 KB, 21 KB from the limit before the documents panel). The caps moved to `@inmolink/contracts/values`; `perf:bundle` now fails if zod comes back (190.5 KB).
- Should fix → S5-F2: listing purge needs a partial `(deleted_at)` index and a continuation when a run ends full (2,000 listings/hour cap); orphan sweep cursors.
- Should fix → S5-F3: approving a 2,000-unit repricing writes 6,000 outbox rows (36k bind parameters) in one transaction; `getPriceList` reads the 2,000-line `entries` it never returns; list columns.

## Demo script for Shahzaib

Local stack. The dev database needs migrations 0059–0063 and the latest RLS. Every seeded login uses the password **`Inmolink-demo-2026`**.

1. `pnpm infra:up`, then `pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:rls && pnpm db:seed`, then `pnpm dev`. Open <http://localhost:3100>.
2. Log in as **`admin@nova-obra.demo.inmolink.test`** (the developer). Open **Preferred agencies** and add *Costa Homes*.
3. Open **Developments → New**: give a reference, a name, a status and a location, then save. On the development page, set the commission (e.g. 5 % + VAT) and tick "units and prices are current".
4. In **Units**, import a CSV with 48 rows (`ref;type;bedrooms;price`, Spanish `;` and `1.250.000,50` prices work). Fix any line the checker flags. Tick three units and set them **Reserved** in bulk; edit one price inline.
5. In **Documents**, upload a brochure PDF and mark it **shared**; upload a contract PDF and leave it private. Try a JPEG renamed `.pdf`: it is refused. Open one: it downloads through a short signed link.
6. In **Price lists**, upload a CSV (`ref,price[,status]`) with a few changed prices, a new reference and one missing: the diff view shows changed, new and missing units. Open an older version: its diff loads on demand. **Approve** the latest: the unit table refreshes with the new prices.
7. In **Sharing**, switch to **Private network** and tick *Costa Homes*. Save.
8. Log in as **`admin@costa-homes.demo.inmolink.test`**: the development opens read-only with its units and commission, the shared brochure (not the contract) and the **override panel** — write Costa Homes' own title and description. Switch on **Client Mode**: commission disappears.
9. Log in as **`admin@marbella-prime.demo.inmolink.test`**: the development is not found (private network, not allowed).
